header: The designers who will be on your project
subheadline: No account managers and no handover to a delivery team after the pitch. The people below run the kickoff, the Thursday critique and the 8:00 call when something breaks.

members.name: Tomás Ferreira
members.bio: Sets the direction on every project and draws the first version himself. He worked on interfaces for fifteen years before the studio, mostly in logistics.

members.name: Sofia Reis
members.bio: Turns four weeks of interview notes into the one problem worth solving. Then she writes the brief the team works from.

members.name: Bruno Salgado
members.bio: Builds the clickable prototype that real users test, usually within nine working days of the first sketch.
